title: Kissed Golden Portuguese Semolina Grill
description: A traditional Portuguese dish featuring semolina, grilled to perfection in a scallop shell, perfect for a sick day, this resinous and bouncy qq semolina grill is a low carb friendly option
instructions: Preheat the yakimono grill to medium high heat
In a large bowl whisk together semolina, eggs, olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and black pepper
Let the mixture rest for 10 minutes to allow the semolina to absorb the liquid
Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a small oval
Place each oval onto a scallop shell
Brush the tops with a little bit of olive oil
Place the scallop shells onto the preheated grill and cook for 5 minutes on each side
Remove the shells from the grill and let them rest for a minute or two before serving
